description.value: Wicked Cafe is a coffee-focused cafe on West 7th Avenue in Vancouver, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The business operates on a cashless-only basis, accepting credit and debit cards. Its location in a residential-commercial neighbourhood on the west side of Vancouver makes it a convenient stop for cyclists riding the nearby routes.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 87m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The URL provided is an Instagram profile, but the fetched content consists entirely of Instagram's generic login/system pages — no cafe-specific content was accessible. All amenity evidence therefore relies solely on OSM tags. The OSM record carries a check_date of 2024-02-16 and looks_closed=false, supporting that the business is real and open; however, per the rules, OSM amenity tags (including internet_access=wlan) cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, so all amenities remain null.

The fetched content returned only Instagram's generic login and system pages — no cafe-specific content, bio, address, or hours were accessible.
